mcp_tools.name: javascript_review_and_build
mcp_tools.title: JavaScript review and build
mcp_tools.description: Submits a JavaScript review-and-build record (modules and strictness, async discipline, DOM safety, environment and bundle, tests and red lines) and returns a deterministic JAVASCRIPT_REVIEW_SOUND / JAVASCRIPT_REVIEW_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-file ESM, var and promise-handling checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it runs no code.

inputSchema.description: The javascript review and build manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

files.description: Declared files: {name, esm_module, var_present, unhandled_promise_present, inner_html_with_user_input_present}.

expect.notes: All fields satisfy skill quality gates and red lines; one ESM file, no var, no unhandled promises, no innerHTML injection.
